BOOM, BELGIUM → A GLOBAL COMMUNITY

A place becomes a world.

Electronic music is the starting point.
The experience is the difference.

Tomorrowland began in 2005 in Boom, Belgium. Its home, De Schorre, becomes a temporary fantasy world where stages, stories and shared rituals surround the music.

The brand’s scale is visible. Its deeper strategic question is less obvious: why do people feel part of something before they arrive—and long after they leave?

About this classroom companion

A standalone learning experience informed by our group’s research and Tomorrowland’s official history. Framework applications and exercises are educational interpretations, not measured campaign results.

Educational case study · Not an official Tomorrowland website.
History and festival background checked against official sources on 3 November 2026.

Course research: Kapferer’s Brand Identity Prism; Keller’s Customer-Based Brand Equity; Schmitt’s Experiential Marketing; Simonin & Ruth’s brand-alliance research. The five partnership stages are the group’s synthesis.
